name: Nexus Mods App
note: The Nexus Mods app. It sets no ProductName of its own, so .NET writes its assembly name, "NexusMods.App" (src/NexusMods.App/NexusMods.App.csproj and Directory.Build.props set none). Not yet checked on a real copy in Magic Kettle: only the cover depends on it. The cover is Magic Kettle's own: the program's logo from its repository on a background in its colours, with its name. Without one its card showed only the small icon from the exe.

credits.what: cover, made from the app's icon (Nexus-Icon.png)
